Salary:
ABOUT YOU

The Ideal candidate:

• Comp Sci or Info System Tech student
• Programming knowledge is a must
• Flexible schedule but be able to work at least 2-3 days of the week (M-F), for a minimum of 20 hours a week, between the hours of 9am to 6pm
• Junior or Senior in a four year college/university preferred
• Detail oriented, a quick learner, and a self starter
• Honest and ethical

What You Will be Doing:

• Program in some of the leading programming languages in Go, node.js, and react.js
• Work with containers and with cloud computing like AWS and Azure
• Use support tools such as Github and JIRA
• Create your own path

ABOUT US

We provide consulting and programming services to the customers in the healthcare IT domain. We are looking for an industrious person that will participate in various in-house IT projects.

Additional Info:

To apply please include your resume with a short cover paragraph. Your resume will need to be verifiable.(Applications without a resume and a short cover paragraph will be auto rejected and not reviewed.)
